verdict.rationale: A business password manager could plausibly offer push-based sign-in with phishing defenses and admin-enforced MFA policies, so this story applies to 1Password. However, the evidence pack documents no push sign-in, number matching, location context, or admin MFA enforcement. Touch ID/Windows Hello CLI sign-in, passkey storage and stored OTPs are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
